app.title: Zonup panel
auth.noAccess: No panel is available for this account. Contact the super admin.
login.title: Sign in to panel
login.subtitle: Enter the login and password given by the super admin
login.side.title: Club management
login.side.text: Operators run their club, managers monitor linked branches.
forcePw.title: Set a new password
forcePw.body: You were given a temporary password. Set your own password to continue.
platform.title: Platform
club.newHint: Each branch is a separate club with its own operator. For 2 branches, create twice.
club.name: Club / branch name
club.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password — changed on first login
user.resetConfirm: Generate a temporary password? Current sessions will be closed.
creds.title: Login credentials
creds.body: Give these to the staff member. The password is shown only now — it cannot be viewed later.
creds.mustChange: Will change the password on first login
operator.title: My club
operator.idHint: Tell this number to your manager. When they enter it, a confirmation code appears here — tell them that code too.
operator.noManagers: No manager has linked this club yet
operator.soon: Sessions, cash desk and reports will appear here — soon.
managerPanel.title: My clubs
managerPanel.addHint: Enter the 7-digit User ID from the operator's profile — a confirmation code goes to the operator's panel
managerPanel.empty: No clubs yet. Ask the operator for their User ID and enter it above.
managerPanel.removeConfirm: Send a request to the super admin to leave this club?
managerPanel.soon: Revenue, occupancy and shift reports — soon.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND.OPERATOR_NOT_FOUND: No operator with this User ID
errors.CONFLICT.ALREADY_LINKED: This club is already in your list
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.SAME_AS_TEMPORAR: New password must differ from the temporary one
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SECONDS: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} s.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_MINUTES: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} min.
operator.requestsHint: A manager entered your User ID. Only share the code with a manager you know.
operator.removeConfirm: This manager will no longer see your club. Continue?
managerPanel.codeHint: A 6-digit code appeared in the operator's panel. Ask the operator for it and enter it here.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: Code expired. Enter the User ID again.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Enter the User ID again.
club.nameHint: Name from the application. Fix it if wrong — the corrected name is saved to the application too.
map.noKey: Map is not configured: Yandex Maps key is missing (NEXT_PUBLIC_YANDEX_MAPS_KEY). Contact the administrator.
location.setupTitle: Mark your club on the map
location.setupText: To open the «{club}» panel, first mark the exact club location. Customers will find the club by this point.
location.step1: Type part of the address: district, street, landmark or metro.
location.step2: The map zooms into the area — find your club building and click it.
location.step3: Drag the red pin if needed, check the address and press «Save».
location.geoDenied: Location access denied — use search or the map
location.noResults: Nothing found. Try a shorter query or find it on the map.
location.addressHint: Filled from the map — adjust if needed (floor, landmark)
location.pickFirst: Mark the place on the map first
location.notSetLong: The operator has not marked the location yet
removal.pageHint: To remove a manager, a request is sent. The super admin contacts you and the manager, then approves.
removal.explain: A request to remove {name} goes to the super admin. Until approved, the manager still sees the club.
removal.adminHint: An operator asked to remove a manager, or a manager asked to leave a club. Contact both sides, then decide.
removal.approveExplain: {manager} will be removed from «{club}» and will no longer see it.
removal.notePlaceholder: E.g. talked to both sides, the manager agreed
errors.CONFLICT.REMOVAL_PENDING: A request for this manager is already pending
zone.hint: Split your club into zones (VIP, General ...) and add tariffs to each.
zone.empty: No zones yet. Add e.g. «VIP» and «General».
zone.name: Zone name
zone.deleteConfirm: Delete zone «{name}» and all its tariffs?
tariff.empty: No tariffs in this zone yet
tariff.name: Tariff name
tariff.hourlyHint: Customer pays for actual time — enter the price per hour.
tariff.packageHint: Fixed price for a set time (e.g. 3 hours — 60,000 UZS).
tariff.window: Valid only at certain hours (e.g. night pack)
tariff.invalidPrice: Enter the price in UZS (digits only)
tariff.invalidDuration: Duration must be at least 0.25 h
hours.hint: If closing is before opening (e.g. 10:00 — 02:00), the club closes the next night.
hours.notSet: Working hours are not set yet — check the template and save.
errors.CONFLICT.ZONE_NAME_TAKEN: A zone with this name already exists
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.INVALID_TIME: Check the time: opening and closing must differ
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.INVALID_WINDOW: Enter the full window (from and to must differ)
managerPanel.noZonesLong: The operator hasn't added zones and tariffs yet
managerPanel.hoursNotSet: The operator hasn't set working hours
share.title: Share this club
share.instagramHint: On a phone this opens Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp and more. On a computer, download the image and post it to your story.
share.noNative: This browser can't share directly — download the image or copy the link.
share.notPublic: The club isn't public yet: it's not on the map or it's suspended. Once marked, the image will be ready.
managerPanel.removePending: Under super admin review. The club stays in your list until approved.
managerPanel.removeByOperator: The operator asked to remove you from this club. The super admin will contact you.
errors.CONFLICT.APPLICATION_HAS_CLUBS: A club was created from this application — it can't be deleted
layout.title: Floor plan
layout.hint: Pick a zone — seats are placed automatically from its device count. Drag them around, draw walls, aisles, doors and more, then save.
layout.needDevices: This zone has no device count. Edit the zone and set it first:
layout.draftHint: This is an automatic arrangement — not saved yet. Adjust it and press «Save».
layout.autoConfirm: All seats will be re-placed and decorations removed. Continue?
layout.trayHint: Drag these into the hall. You can also drag seats out of the hall here.
layout.tool.moveHint: Drag devices. Dropping on an occupied cell swaps them.
layout.tool.paintHint: Click a cell or click-and-drag to paint. Click the same item again to remove it.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.DEVICES_COUNT_RE: Set the zone's device count first
plan.hint: Monthly plans for clubs. Each plan limits the number of halls and total devices.
plan.empty: No plans yet. Create one, e.g. Standard — 5 halls, 50 devices, 100 000 UZS.
plan.name: Plan name
plan.editNote: Changes apply immediately to every club on this plan.
sub.hint: Each club (branch) subscription. Expired or ending within 3 days come first. Clubs are not closed — you only get an alert.
sub.alertBanner: {n} club subscriptions expired or about to expire
sub.cancelConfirm: Cancel the subscription? The club will have no limits.
sub.noPlans: No active plans. Create one first:
sub.replaceNote: The current subscription will be replaced; the period starts today.
sub.overLimit: The club already has {z} halls and {d} devices — over this plan's limit. Existing ones stay; new ones can't be added.
sub.extendHint: Extend when payment is received. Added from the end date (or today if expired).
errors.CONFLICT.PLAN_ZONES_LIMIT: Your plan's hall limit is reached. Contact the admin to upgrade.
errors.CONFLICT.PLAN_DEVICES_LIMIT: This exceeds your plan's device limit. Contact the admin to upgrade.
errors.CONFLICT.PLAN_NAME_TAKEN: A plan with this name already exists
sub.title: Subscription (plan)
sub.operatorPayHint: Contact the platform admin to pay.
opBooking.hint: Customer bookings. Payment is taken at the club. Mark «Arrived» on arrival, «No-show» if they don't come — the seat is freed.
opBooking.confirm.no-show: Mark as no-show? The seat will be freed.
opBooking.confirm.cancel: Cancel the booking? Let the customer know first.
opNew.title: New bookings
opNew.hint: Upcoming bookings, newest first. Updates automatically.
opDesk.contact.title: 1. Call the customer
opDesk.contact.hint: After the call, pick the result — it saves instantly. It does not change the booking status.
opDesk.arriveLater: The customer will tell their code on arrival — enter it in the field above. This button opens 30 minutes before the booking.
opDesk.arriveConfirm: Has {name} (#{code}) arrived at the club now? This cannot be undone.
opBooking.confirm.undo-check-in: Marked by mistake? The booking goes back to upcoming.
walkIn.title: Walk-in booking
walkIn.hint: For a customer who came in person: time → hours → seats. The seat is taken immediately and won't show as free online.
walkIn.name: Customer name (optional)
walkIn.checkIn: Customer is here — mark arrived now
walkIn.doneNow: Seat taken — customer is at the club
walkIn.openHint: No end time is set: you stop the session, and the amount is calculated then at the hourly rate.
walkIn.openUntilBooked: Only until {time} — this seat is booked after that
walkIn.openTotalHint: The total is calculated when the session is stopped
opOpen.title: Open time
opOpen.stopConfirm: Stop the session? The amount is calculated up to now and the seat is freed.
errors.CONFLICT.DEVICE_BUSY: The selected seat is taken — pick another
errors.CONFLICT.OPEN_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: This seat has a booking soon — open time needs at least 30 free minutes
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.NO_HOURLY_TARIFF: This zone has no hourly tariff — open time is not available
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.OUTSIDE_HOURS: The club is closed right now — check the working hours
images.title: Logo and club photo
images.subtitle: Shown on the customer site: club page, map and lists.
images.logoHint: Square works best. PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB. Transparency is kept.
images.photoHint: The hall or entrance; landscape photos look best. PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.INVALID_IMAGE: Couldn't open the image. Choose a PNG, JPG or WEBP file.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARG: The file is too large — 10 MB max.
backup.hint: Download a backup of the database and uploaded images as a single zip file. It is not kept on the server — store it yourself.
backup.fullNote: Full copy: the whole database (the system can be fully restored from it) and all images.
backup.periodNote: Partial copy: records created or changed {from} — {to} (one CSV file per table) and images uploaded on those days. The system cannot be fully restored from it — choose “All time” for that.
backup.invalidPeriod: Pick both dates; the start must not be after the end.
backup.sensitive: The file contains customer phone numbers and password hashes. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it.
backup.ready: Backup is ready — the download has started
backup.linkExpired: The link has expired. Create the backup again if you still need it.
errors.CONFLICT.BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS: Another backup is being prepared. Try again in a moment.
errors.NOT_FOUND.BACKUP_EXPIRED: The backup file was not found or the link has expired.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.BACKUP_FAILED: The backup failed. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.PG_TOOLS_MISSING: pg_dump is not installed on the server — backups are unavailable.
